title: Sunday Morning (Chas and Wilma McIvor)
style: folk country acoustic guitar warm duet male female vocal 96bpm brushed drums gentle storytelling intimate family Sunday morning Perth love quiet
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — Chas]
Sunday morning and the kettle's on before the birds decide
She's already been in the garden — I can tell by what's outside
The clippers on the table and the gloves left on the step
Sunday morning and the garden's had its bath already — yep

[Verse 2 — Wilma]
He's at the kitchen table with his tea and his particular stare
At something out the window that is definitely there
I don't ask what he's thinking because the thinking will resolve
Sunday morning is the time when everything can solve

[Chorus — Both]
Sunday morning, Sunday morning
Before the family phones, before the week's returning
Sunday morning, Sunday morning
The garden and the kettle and the light
Sunday morning — both of us — getting it right
The gardens still growing
That's my boy

[Bridge — Chas]
We've done this Sunday morning for more decades than I'll count
She does the garden first and I do tea without
Having to ask or plan — we know the Sunday protocol
And the Sunday morning holds us like the whole — it's all

[Outro — Both voices]
Sunday morning knows us… the kettle knows… the garden knows…
The gardens still growing
